walkthroughs.body_html:
Complete: octane: 2C8H18 + 25O2 -> 16CO2 + 18H2O.

Incomplete: produces CO and/or C (soot).

Sulfur in fuels -> SO2 -> acid rain.

Hot engines: N2 + O2 -> NOx.

Soot: particulates -> respiratory issues, global dimming.

2H2 + O2 -> 2H2O. No CO2 produced.

But: storing H2 is hard; making H2 may use fossil energy.
